_provenance.source: DESNZ Energy Trends Table ET 6.1, 'Annual' worksheet: rows 25-40 'ELECTRICITY GENERATED (GWh)' and rows 42-54 'LOAD FACTORS (%)'. Same workbook already cited for installed capacity (w1_7_dukes_installed_capacity_annual.json) and mix share (w1_7_desnz_mix_share_annual.json) -- one source, three different tables within it.
_provenance.units: generation_gwh: GWh (annual electricity generated); load_factor_pct: percent (annual average load factor, note 12)
_provenance.measurement_basis: Per Notes 6/8/12: generation is actual output where metered (mostly larger RO/FiT-accredited sites), load factor = actual generation / (installed capacity x hours in year), DESNZ own calculation -- same independent collection pipeline as the mix-share table (row 56-64), NOT the Elexon AGWS settlement feed sim/weather_price_chain.py ingests.
_provenance.used_by: sim/renewable_capacity_trend.py -- real_generation_*_gwh(), real_load_factor(), implied_generation_gwh() (capacity x load factor -> energy), check_capacity_load_factor_reconciles_to_generation, check_onshore_offshore_generation_split_vs_real
_provenance.note_offshore: offshore = 'Offshore wind' generation row 27, already combined (unlike the capacity table which splits seabed/floating -- the generation/load-factor tables report offshore as one series).
